name: Prediction block is visible above the fold on desktop
description: When a visitor opens a match permalink at a desktop viewport, the prediction block is visible without scrolling.

planSteps.description: Resize the viewport to a 1280 by 800 desktop size
Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Verify the prediction block sits within the initial viewport and is fully visible at the desktop size without scrolling down
